government.name: Sixth Labour Government
government.notes: National won the most seats (56) but no majority. Winston Peters announced on 19 Oct 2017 that NZ First (9) would form a coalition with Labour (46); the Greens (8) signed a confidence-and-supply agreement the same day (63 of 120 seats). Sworn in 26 Oct 2017. Peters became Deputy PM.

notes: Electorate majorities/runners-up are taken from the official-count vote tables in each electorate's Wikipedia article (which cite the Electoral Commission's official results pages); where the summary table, the article's majority box and the candidate vote counts disagree, the value two of them agree on is used – see 'majority_corrections'.

Cross-check: national party-vote totals vs the sum of per-electorate official party votes in the electorate articles – largest gap -175 votes (national, 0.01% of valid votes); gaps are attributed to transcription errors in individual electorate articles, and the national (Electoral Commission summary) figures are used.
